Name: Lynneas Witchy and Purple Weapons - with Goth Haley Variant
Author: Lynneaura
Description:
[size=3]Welcome to my 2nd mod! 

This time I recolored all the weapons to fit in with my existing color palette and the look of my tools <3

I made the meowmere a black cat 'cause you know? witches? haha I know I'm funny :D

In the standard version haley's curling iron is pink.
In the goth haley version it's purple with dark grey details.

choose what you like best <3

[b]Please make sure to only pick ONE version![/b][/size]
